messages:
Mike (Sales): Passing CobaltVue to CS — SOW signed for Dedicated (3 GPUs) + VPC + Okta SSO. Go-live target = ~4 weeks. Main risks: SSO metadata/timing, data import of 6 months logs, unknown token usage spikes. Need staging Dedicated provisioned and a perf check. Customer asks: model parity vs our hosted baseline. See SOW attachments: https://files.example/cobaltvue/sow.pdf

Priya (CS): Thanks — I’ll own onboarding lead and runbook. Weekly syncs, and I’ll coordinate eng/support triage. Immediate asks: staging Dedicated + VPC, Okta metadata, prompt eval harness (small set). @Jordan can you own SSO smoke tests? @Eli can you validate capacity estimates?

Jordan (Support): I can do SSO smoke tests once we get metadata. Need Okta SAML metadata + a test admin user. Also confirm if SCIM provisioning is required or if manual user add is acceptable.

Eli (Eng): I’ll run capacity/perf estimate. Need expected RPS, average and max prompt lengths, and typical concurrency. Perf template here: https://docs.internal/perf-template. ETA 48h after info. If bursts are likely, suggest burst pool + canary routing.

Priya (CS): Customer reported hallucination concerns in earlier evals — request a 20-prompt harness from Sales to validate quality before go-live and wire regression alerts into Console. Also will prepare a rollback/runbook for model fallback.

Mike (Sales): Uploaded prompt set: https://files.example/cobaltvue/prompts.csv. Okta metadata is attached to the SOW link above. Customer says avg prompt ~120 tokens, max ~600, steady RPS ~0.8, peak ~6 RPS. Renewal note: enterprise discount review in ~10 months; early high usage could impact unit-cost conversations.

Priya (CS): Owners & next steps recap:
- Onboarding lead: Priya (CS)
- SSO verification: Jordan (Support)
- Capacity/perf & quantization recs: Eli (Eng)
- Support escalation contact: Priya (CS) / Ana (Support)

Action items with due windows:
1) Eli: perf estimate + quantization recommendation (due in ~48h)
2) Jordan: SSO smoke test plan + SCIM check (due in ~72h)
3) Priya: create runbook + schedule weekly check-in + add eval harness (due EOD today)
4) Mike: confirm prompt set + share Okta test creds (ASAP)

I created a Jira triage ticket for eng/support: https://jira.example/browse/ONB-1234 — please attach perf sheet and test plan there.

Jordan (Support): :thumbsup: I’ll post the SSO test plan in ONB-1234 and request Okta admin creds. If SCIM is not available we’ll document the manual provisioning flow.

Eli (Eng): Noted. Preliminary recommendation: start with 3x inference nodes, quantized FP16/INT8 trial, plus a 20% burst pool. Will attach perf numbers to the Jira once run. Also flagging latency SLO impact at 600 tokens — might need concurrency throttles.

Ana (Support): Looping in support on-call. I’ll prep the first-week post-go-live on-call rota and the rollback checklist. Will monitor ONB-1234 and add runbook snippets.

Priya (CS): Weekly sync scheduled: Fridays 11:00am PT starting next week. If urgent, ping #cs-urgent. Risk tags: SSO timing, prompt hallucination/quality. I’ll add a renewal-flag note to account health dashboard and capture feedback items in the CS notes.

onboard-bot: Jira ONB-1234 created, due dates set for owners (Eli: +48h, Jordan: +72h, Priya: EOD).

Mike (Sales): Thanks all — will follow up with Okta creds and any additional compliance attachments.

Priya (CS): Great — closing the loop here. Priya will post a starter-runbook in the Jira and invite customer to a kickoff call once SSO creds are available.
